$comment: Source files that exist but appear in no coverage report, because no spec imports them.
v8 does not report such a file as 0% — it omits it from the denominator, so untested code
is invisible rather than failing. The coverage gate fails on any entry here that is absent
or expired, so this debt is dated and visible instead of silently absorbed.
An entry is NOT permission to leave the file untested. It is a record that the file is
untested, with a date by which that stops being acceptable. Deleting the entry and adding
a spec is the intended way out; extending the date is a decision someone has to make

libs/shared/adf-hx-bridge/src/lib/api/nu.reason: adf-hx API port with no spec anywhere in the repo. Phase 3 shipped twelve of these as its deliverable and adf-hx-bridge reported 65.61% without any of them in the denominator. Ports are thin adapters over NuxeoApiBase, which is itself well covered — but 'thin' is an assertion no test currently makes.
adf-hx API port, no spec references. Copy/move are destructive operations; the absence of a test is worse here than on a read path.

libs/shared/adf-hx-bridge/src/lib/api/hx.reason: Two specs reference this module, but they live outside adf-hx-bridge, so it is instrumented under another project's report and absent from this one. Query-literal escaping is exactly the class of code where a wrong pattern is worse than none — the same phase fixed CQL and regex injection in three gate scripts — so it should be covered by a spec inside its own project.

libs/shared/adf-hx-bridge/src/lib/mappin.reason: Mapper between Nuxeo and adf-hx shapes, no spec. Mappers fail silently by emitting a wrong-but-valid object.

libs/shared/adf-hx-bridge/src/lib/servic.reason: ACL service with no spec. Client-side permission logic is not a security control — Nuxeo gates server-side — but a wrong ACL read still shows a user actions they cannot perform.

libs/shared/adf-hx-bridge/src/lib/ui/hxp.reason: Presentational component, no spec. Lower risk than the API ports, hence the later date.

libs/shared/adf-hx-bridge/src/lib/utils/.reason: Pure predicates with no spec — the cheapest possible thing to test, which is why the date is early.

libs/shared/adf-hx-bridge/src/providers..reason: Provider wiring. Exercised indirectly wherever the bridge is configured, but nothing imports it under this project's own tests.

libs/features/browse/src/adf-hx-poc.ts.reason: Proof-of-concept entry point retained from the pre-Beta spike. A candidate for deletion rather than a spec — if nothing ships it, it should not be in the tree.

libs/features/browse/src/search-adf-hx.t.reason: Barrel for the adf-hx search surface; no test reaches it.

libs/features/browse/src/lib/adf-hx-colu.reason: Column definitions for the adf-hx browse surface, no spec.

libs/features/browse/src/lib/search-adf-.reason: adf-hx search surface component, no spec.

libs/shared/extensions/src/lib/provide-s.reason: Provider function in a project reporting 96.04% — one of only four counted as meeting the Beta bar. That count is read by leadership, so an uncovered provider in a bar-clearing project is the most misleading entry in this file.

libs/shared/nuxeo-client/src/lib/models/.reason: Model types with little executable code; kept dated rather than excluded so the judgement is recorded.
